summary: The tape family's generalizing signal is RECENT order-flow alignment with the trade: fill-bar delta confirming direction (fill_delta_conf) is the single strongest separator (WR +17.8pp 2025 / +18.0pp 2026 in the all slice, passing WR+$ floors in every window and pattern sub-slice), and last-15-min alignment (conf_last15 ~ d15_conf, inverse of fade_last15) adds nearly independent signal (phi 0.21) concentrated in the gold window (+21.8/+11.5pp); trades with both flags win 36-43% vs 15-17% with neither. The effect follows a recency gradient — fill-bar > 5-min > 15-min > 30-min all pass in the same direction, while whole-premarket cumulative alignment (pm_sofar_conf, pm_sofar_cvd) is flat to negative on dollars, and heavy 15-min tape AGAINST the trade (bottom-quartile d15__dir) is the sharpest loser trait (gold: +16.4/+23.1pp for avoiding it). Honest nulls: opening-session sofar features (gold), fill_vol_rel, pathpos, absorption_y, stacked_imb_y, path_hi, pm_sofar_patheff/eff/crosses all fail; the B2 loud-tape magnitude penalty passes floors but largely restates the signed alignment effect; cvd_conf/conf_PM in pre pass only the $ criterion with 2025 WR just under the 8pp floor.
